verified_facts.text: Andaz Napa is a boutique hotel in downtown Napa.
verified_facts.excerpt: Be inspired by the charm of Napa Wine Country from our boutique downtown hotel.

verified_facts.text: Oxbow Public Market and the Napa Valley Wine Train are both within walking distance of the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience essential Napa, including Oxbow Public Market and the Napa Valley Wine Train, which are both located within walking distance of our hotel.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers exclusive hotel events and a tasting room exploring arts, wine and culinary culture.
verified_facts.excerpt: Explore the arts, wine and culinary culture through exclusive hotel events, a tasting room and world-class dining.

verified_facts.text: Rooms are rustic-chic, with hardwood floors and deep soaking tubs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Retreat to the rustic-chic boutique hotel rooms of Andaz Napa, featuring hardwood floors and deep soaking tubs.

verified_facts.text: Guests can choose a loft accommodation with a sleek fireplace or a suite with a furnished terrace overlooking downtown Napa.
verified_facts.excerpt: Choose a loft accommodation with a sleek fireplace or upgrade to a suite with a furnished terrace overlooking the heart of downtown Napa.

verified_facts.text: Several rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows and marble bathrooms with rain showers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy a naturally lit space with floor-to-ceiling windows to admire Napa Valley views and a marble bathroom with a rain shower.

verified_facts.text: The Andaz Tower Suite has 12-foot ceilings, a separate bedroom and an oversized soaking tub for two.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy your stay in this suite with soaring 12-foot ceilings, hardwood floors and a separate bedroom with a king bed. Admire panoramic views of downtown Napa from the floor-to-ceiling windows or relax in the oversized soaking tub for two.

verified_facts.text: The Andaz Harvest Suite has a soaking tub for two and a retractable glass wall that opens to a furnished balcony.
verified_facts.excerpt: Indulge in this suite featuring a king bed with a soaking tub for two. Lounge in the spacious separate living area and a retractable glass wall that opens to a furnished balcony.

verified_facts.text: The Andaz Vintner Suite has a separate bedroom, a soaking tub for two, a dual-sided glass fireplace, a dining area and a furnished terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Luxuriate in this Napa suite featuring a separate bedroom with a king bed, a soaking tub for two and a dual-sided glass fireplace. Gather at the table in the dining area, the sofas in the living room or on the furnished terrace.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have Malin + Goetz bath toiletries.
verified_facts.excerpt: Malin + Goetz Bath Toiletries

verified_facts.text: Mercantile Terrace is a second-floor outdoor restaurant with fire pits and cabanas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Unwind with outdoor dining and drinks at our signature downtown Napa restaurant, Mercantile Terrace, located on the 2nd floor. Get cozy around fire pits or in a comfortable cabana

verified_facts.text: Mercantile Terrace mixologists craft cocktails with ingredients native to Napa Valley and Northern California.
verified_facts.excerpt: Expert mixologists craft refreshing beverages and cocktails with ingredients native to Napa Valley and Northern California.

verified_facts.text: Mercantile Social serves farm-fresh seasonal food with local Napa ingredients alongside artisanal drinks and regional wine.
verified_facts.excerpt: Mercantile Social offers farm-fresh seasonal foods with local Napa ingredients, from salads and smoothies to grass-fed beef burgers.

verified_facts.text: Andaz Farmers Table serves a farm-to-table breakfast around a communal dining table, with a Barista Bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: Gather around the communal dining table for handcrafted breakfast foods that highlight the bounty of the Napa Valley or pick up an invigorating coffee beverage from the Barista Bar.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is pet friendly and provides a doggy bed, two bowls and treats for dogs.
verified_facts.excerpt: we will gladly provide a doggy bed, two bowls, and treats for your pup(s).

verified_facts.text: Self-parking is at the Clay Street Garage, directly behind the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests can park vehicles at the Clay Street Garage, located directly behind the hotel.
